title: SecPO: Principled Adversarial Training for Prompt Injection Security
title_zh: SecPO：面向提示注入安全的原则性对抗训练

paragraphs.en: 提出SecPO损失与对抗训练流水线，大幅降低自适应提示注入攻击成功率且不损害模型良性任务效用。 Recognized as a top threat to AI agents, prompt injection allows instructions from untrusted data (email, documents, websites) to manipulate the agent's operation. The existing best-defended LLM, Meta-SecAlign, is trained with the DPO loss but still suffers from attack success rates (ASRs) approaching 100% under adaptive prompt injections. One reason is that DPO anchors the model around the undefended reference model, which is insecure. We show an idealized reference model---an injection-invariant, utility-preserving oracle---can nevertheless be approximated, as its output distribution in training is interestingly accessible. This new observation motivates a theoretically principled SecPO loss. Another Meta-SecAlign shortcoming is that it trains on weak simulated attacks. We implement an efficient adversarial training (AT) pipeline that synthesizes strong injected inputs (best@240), and train the model on them. Our AT reduces ASRs by 1.5-14.5$\times$ across three SoTA adaptive attacks, compared with Meta-SecAlign; the SecPO loss reduces them by a further 2.4-4.6$\times$ compared with using DPO loss. In agentic workflows, our SecPO + AT Qwen3.6-27B is much more secure than Meta-SecAlign: 8.8% vs. 78.8% AgentDojo ASR@800 under the AttackerMovesSecond attack. Moreover, our defended model shows no noticeable reduction in benign utility in nine benchmarks covering agentic tool calling, instruction following, science, and math. We release our $\href{//github.com/Sizhe-Chen/SecPO}{\text{code}}$, $\href{//huggingface.co/datasets/Sizhe-Chen/Qwen3.6-27B-Instruct-SecPO-trainset}{\text{training data}}$ (with optimized injections from AT), and $\href{//huggingface.co/Sizhe-Chen/Qwen3.6-27B-Instruct-SecPO}{\text{model}}$.
paragraphs.zh: 提出SecPO损失与对抗训练流水线，大幅降低自适应提示注入攻击成功率且不损害模型良性任务效用。提示注入被公认为智能体面临的首要威胁之一，它允许来自不可信数据（电子邮件、文档、网站）中的指令操纵智能体的运行。 现有防御最强的LLM Meta-SecAlign采用DPO损失进行训练，但在自适应提示注入下攻击成功率（ASR）仍接近100%。 原因之一在于DPO将模型锚定在未防御的参考模型上，而该参考模型本身并不安全。 我们证明，一个理想化的参考模型——即对注入不变、且保持效用的oracle——仍然可以被近似，因为其在训练中的输出分布出人意料地可以获取。 这一新发现推动我们提出了具有理论依据的SecPO损失。 Meta-SecAlign的另一个缺陷是它仅用较弱的模拟攻击进行训练。 我们实现了一个高效的对抗训练（AT）流水线，可合成强注入输入（best@240），并用它们训练模型。 与Meta-SecAlign相比，我们的AT在三种SoTA自适应攻击下将ASR降低1.5-14.5倍；与使用DPO损失相比，SecPO损失进一步将ASR降低2.4-4.6倍。 在智能体工作流中，我们的SecPO + AT Qwen3.6-27B比Meta-SecAlign安全得多：在AttackerMovesSecond攻击下，AgentDojo ASR@800为8.8%对78.8%。 此外，我们的防御模型在覆盖智能体工具调用、指令遵循、科学与数学的九个基准上，良性效用没有明显下降。 我们发布了 $\href{//github.com/Sizhe-Chen/SecPO}{\text{代码}}$、$\href{//huggingface.co/datasets/Sizhe-Chen/Qwen3.6-27B-Instruct-SecPO-trainset}{\text{训练数据}}$（包含来自AT的优化注入）以及 $\href{//huggingface.co/Sizhe-Chen/Qwen3.6-27B-Instruct-SecPO}{\text{模型}}$。
